* Develop UI screens using React Native under mentorship
* Work on navigation, components, and state management

* Debug and test mobile apps

**Skills Required**

* Strong JavaScript fundamentals
* Basic knowledge of React Native
* Interest in mobile app development
* Willingness to learn modern tools and frameworks

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Expo
* Any academic project in mobile development
* Knowledge of Git and basic development tools
